required_evidence: Professionally reviewed public query/candidate none/partial/direct labels
Recall audit distinguishing missing corpus/index from classifier errors
Pinned upstream training interface and model/source licensing review
Measured resource pilot and separate calibration/holdout data
Held-out comparison showing improvement and an immutable rollback checkpoint
limitations: Existing 200 draft cases are unreviewed and cannot establish a training need.
Training cannot retrieve absent or unindexed legal passages.
Private documents are not exported for training.
LAYA remains mandatory in shadow mode; ranking activation requires separate reviewed evidence.
